title: Regulatory & Accreditation
outline: NAHQ CPHQ Detailed Content Outline (2024 R2b, in 2026 handbook)

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: A hospital wants external recognition specifically for its stroke program. Which option is MOST appropriate?

options.A: Disease-specific (program) certification
options.B: State hospital licensure renewal
options.C: Organization-wide hospital accreditation
options.D: ISO 9001 quality management certification

questions.explanation_en: Certification can recognize a specific program or service (e.g., stroke, cardiac). Licensure is mandatory government permission to operate; accreditation evaluates the whole organization; ISO 9001 certifies a quality management system.
questions.explanation_ar: برنامج السكتة الدماغية يحتاج شهادة خاصة بالمرض لا اعتماداً للمنشأة كاملة.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: What does 'deemed status' mean for a US hospital?

options.A: The hospital becomes exempt from state licensure requirements
options.B: An approved accreditor's survey is accepted for CMS CoP compliance
options.C: The hospital no longer needs to report quality measures to CMS
options.D: The hospital is permanently accredited and never needs a resurvey

questions.explanation_en: Deemed status lets an approved accreditor's survey substitute for a state/CMS certification survey. It does not remove licensure, reporting, or resurvey requirements; CMS can still conduct validation or complaint surveys.
questions.explanation_ar: الوضع المعتبر يعني قبول CMS باعتماد جهة معتمدة كدليل على استيفاء شروط المشاركة.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: Leadership is choosing among accreditation bodies. Which factor should carry the MOST weight?

options.A: Which body has the shortest and least disruptive survey
options.B: Which body most competitor hospitals in the region use
options.C: Fit with regulatory, payer, and strategic needs
options.D: The lowest survey fee

questions.explanation_en: Selection should be driven by whether the program satisfies regulatory and payer requirements and supports strategy and patient population. Cost and survey length are secondary.
questions.explanation_ar: اختر جهة الاعتماد حسب المتطلبات التنظيمية والدافعين والاستراتيجية لا حسب التكلفة.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: Which organization accredits the accreditation bodies and standards themselves, rather than individual hospitals?

options.A: Joint Commission International (JCI) Accreditation Program
options.B: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) survey division
options.C: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) health plan program
options.D: ISQua (International Society for Quality in Health Care)

questions.explanation_en: ISQua's External Evaluation Association evaluates accreditation bodies, standards, and surveyor training programs. JCI and NCQA accredit organizations/plans; CMS is a regulator and payer.
questions.explanation_ar: ISQua تقيّم جهات الاعتماد ومعاييرها وليس المستشفيات.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: A nursing department seeks external recognition for nursing excellence and positive practice environments. Which program fits BEST?

options.A: Magnet Recognition Program
options.B: Baldrige Performance Excellence Award
options.C: Hospital licensure renewal
options.D: Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) certification

questions.explanation_en: Magnet (ANCC) recognizes nursing excellence. Baldrige recognizes organization-wide performance excellence; licensure is mandatory; CLIA applies to laboratories.
questions.explanation_ar: برنامج ماغنت يعترف بالتميز التمريضي.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: A new government regulation affecting discharge planning is published. What should the quality professional do FIRST?

options.A: Wait for the next accreditation survey to see how it is interpreted
options.B: Assess applicability, do a gap analysis, and inform owners
options.C: Email the full text to all staff
options.D: Immediately revise every discharge policy before analyzing the rule

questions.explanation_en: A structured regulatory-tracking process determines applicability, gaps, owners, and timelines before policy changes and targeted education. Mass emails without interpretation are ineffective.
questions.explanation_ar: قيّم انطباق اللائحة وحلل الفجوة ثم أبلغ أصحاب العمليات المسؤولين.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: A state privacy law is more protective of patient information than the federal privacy rule. Which requirement applies?

options.A: The federal rule, because federal law always overrides state law
options.B: Whichever is easier to implement
options.C: The more stringent state requirement
options.D: Neither, until the conflict is resolved in court

questions.explanation_en: In general, the federal privacy rule sets a floor; more stringent (more protective) state privacy laws are not preempted and must be followed.
questions.explanation_ar: القانون المحلي الأكثر حماية للخصوصية هو الذي يُطبّق.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: Under EMTALA, what must a US hospital with an emergency department provide to anyone who comes requesting emergency care?

options.A: Treatment only after insurance coverage has been verified by registration
options.B: Admission to an inpatient bed for every patient who requests emergency care
options.C: Transfer uninsured patients to a public hospital
options.D: A screening exam and stabilization or transfer, regardless of payment

questions.explanation_en: EMTALA requires an appropriate medical screening exam and, if an emergency condition exists, stabilization or appropriate transfer – without delay for financial inquiry.
questions.explanation_ar: EMTALA يُلزم بفحص طبي وتثبيت الحالة أو نقل مناسب دون النظر للقدرة على الدفع.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: A surveyor follows one patient's care from the ED through imaging, the ICU, and pharmacy, interviewing staff along the way. What method is this?

options.A: Individual (patient) tracer
options.B: System tracer of a key process
options.C: Document-only review of the record
options.D: Staff focus group on care delivery

questions.explanation_en: An individual tracer follows an actual patient's journey across departments. A system tracer examines an organization-wide process (e.g., medication management, infection control, data use).
questions.explanation_ar: تتبع مريض واحد عبر الأقسام هو تتبع فردي (Patient tracer).

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: After a survey, the organization must submit a corrective action plan. Which element is MOST critical for sustained compliance?

options.A: A signed statement that staff were reminded of the policy
options.B: Measurable monitoring showing the fix is sustained
options.C: The name of the employee at fault
options.D: A copy of the surveyor's report attached to the plan of correction

questions.explanation_en: Effective plans address root cause and include owner, timeline, and a measure of success with sustained monitoring. 'Staff reminded' is weak, and naming individuals for blame is not the goal.
questions.explanation_ar: خطة التصحيح الفعالة تتضمن مراقبة قابلة للقياس تثبت الاستدامة.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: Which is NOT one of the commonly recognized core elements of an effective compliance program?

options.A: Designating a compliance officer and committee
options.B: Conducting internal auditing and monitoring
options.C: Guaranteeing zero billing errors
options.D: Maintaining open lines of communication such as a hotline

questions.explanation_en: Recognized compliance-program elements include written policies, a compliance officer/committee, training, communication lines, auditing/monitoring, consistent enforcement, and prompt response/corrective action. 'Zero errors' is not a realistic program element.
questions.explanation_ar: ضمان عدم وجود أي خطأ ليس من عناصر برنامج الامتثال.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: During credentialing, which is an example of primary source verification of a physician's license?

options.A: Reviewing a notarized photocopy supplied by the physician
options.B: Accepting a reference letter from a colleague at another hospital
options.C: Checking the license number listed on the physician's résumé
options.D: Confirming the license with the issuing licensing authority

questions.explanation_en: Primary source verification means confirming with the original issuing source (or an approved designated equivalent). Copies and attestations from the applicant are secondary.
questions.explanation_ar: التحقق من المصدر الأساسي يعني التأكد من الجهة المُصدِرة مباشرة.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: Which group of requirements must a US hospital meet to participate in and receive payment from Medicare and Medicaid?

options.A: CMS Conditions of Participation
options.B: NCQA HEDIS performance measures
options.C: ISO 9001 quality management clauses
options.D: Baldrige Performance Excellence criteria

questions.explanation_en: The Conditions of Participation are federal health and safety requirements for Medicare/Medicaid participation. HEDIS measures health plans; ISO and Baldrige are voluntary frameworks.
questions.explanation_ar: شروط المشاركة CoPs متطلبات اتحادية للمشاركة في Medicare وMedicaid.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: Which approach BEST reflects continuous survey readiness?

options.A: Routine self-assessment built into daily operations
options.B: An intensive 'survey blitz' in the month before the expected survey
options.C: Hiring consultants before surveys
options.D: Hiding non-compliant documents until the survey team has left

questions.explanation_en: Readiness is a continuous state: standards are built into daily work, self-assessed, and monitored. Last-minute blitzes are not sustainable and concealment is unethical.
questions.explanation_ar: الجاهزية المستمرة تعني دمج التقييم الذاتي في العمل اليومي.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: Mock surveys/tracers are conducted quarterly. What is their PRIMARY purpose?

options.A: Identify and discipline staff who answer surveyor questions incorrectly
options.B: Find gaps and drive improvement before a real survey
options.C: Replace the actual accreditation survey with an internal assessment
options.D: Producing marketing material

questions.explanation_en: Mock surveys are a learning and gap-identification tool. Using them punitively discourages candor; they do not substitute for the real survey.
questions.explanation_ar: المسوحات التجريبية أداة تعلم لاكتشاف الفجوات قبل المسح الفعلي.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: How should staff be prepared for surveyor interviews?

options.A: Memorize scripted answers
options.B: Instruct staff to refer every surveyor question to the quality department
options.C: Staff can explain their role and find policies and data
options.D: Keep front-line staff away from surveyors as much as possible during visits

questions.explanation_en: Surveyors assess whether staff understand and perform processes. Being able to explain one's own work and locate resources demonstrates real compliance; scripts and avoidance raise concern.
questions.explanation_ar: يجب أن يشرح الموظف دوره ويعرف مكان السياسات والبيانات.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: A surveyor identifies a condition posing an immediate threat to patient life or safety. What is the expected organizational response?

options.A: Address it in the standard 60-day plan of correction with other findings
options.B: Appeal the finding formally before taking any corrective action on the unit
options.C: Wait for the final written report
options.D: Remove the threat immediately and document the action

questions.explanation_en: Immediate threats (e.g., 'immediate jeopardy' in the US) require immediate mitigation; formal plans and appeals come afterward.
questions.explanation_ar: الخطر الداهم يُزال فوراً ويُوثّق قبل التخطيط الروتيني.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: Who is ultimately accountable for an organization's accreditation and regulatory compliance?

options.A: The governing body and senior leadership
options.B: The quality department, which coordinates surveys
options.C: The accreditation surveyor assigned to the hospital
options.D: Front-line staff, who carry out the daily processes

questions.explanation_en: Quality professionals facilitate and coordinate, but leaders and the governing body are accountable; every staff member owns compliance in their own work.
questions.explanation_ar: مجلس الإدارة والقيادة العليا مسؤولون نهائياً عن الامتثال.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: Which statement correctly contrasts licensure and accreditation?

options.A: Both are always voluntary
options.B: Licensure is mandatory; accreditation is usually voluntary
options.C: Accreditation is issued by the state; licensure by private organizations
options.D: Licensure becomes optional once an organization has been accredited

questions.explanation_en: Licensure is a legal requirement granted by government. Accreditation is typically voluntary (though it may be tied to payment or mandated in some countries) and assessed by an accrediting body.
questions.explanation_ar: الترخيص إلزامي من الحكومة، والاعتماد عادة طوعي وفق معايير.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: Compliance with a hand-hygiene standard is monitored monthly by observation. Results are 95% when observers are known but 60% with covert observation. What does this MOST likely indicate?

options.A: Covert observation is inaccurate
options.B: True compliance is 95%, because known observers are better trained
options.C: The Hawthorne effect is inflating observed compliance
options.D: The hand-hygiene standard should be removed as unrealistic for staff

questions.explanation_en: People change behavior when they know they are watched (Hawthorne effect). Monitoring methods should minimize this bias (e.g., unknown observers, electronic monitoring, larger samples).
questions.explanation_ar: أثر هوثورن يرفع الامتثال عندما يعلم الموظفون أنهم مراقبون.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: An international hospital outside the US wants organization-wide accreditation recognized globally to attract medical tourists. Which option fits BEST?

options.A: Joint Commission International (JCI)
options.B: US state hospital licensure
options.C: Magnet recognition for nursing excellence
options.D: CLIA laboratory certification program

questions.explanation_en: JCI provides international organization-wide accreditation; the others are nursing recognition, lab certification, or US licensure.
questions.explanation_ar: اعتماد JCI يناسب الاعتماد الدولي الشامل للمنشأة.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: ISO 9001 certification evaluates which of the following?

options.A: Clinical outcomes of the hospital's stroke program
options.B: Individual physician competence and privileges
options.C: The organization's quality management system
options.D: Nursing excellence and professional practice environment

questions.explanation_en: ISO 9001 certifies that a quality management system meets the standard's requirements.
questions.explanation_ar: شهادة ISO 9001 تقيّم نظام إدارة الجودة.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: A health plan wants recognition of its quality of care and service to members. Which organization is MOST relevant?

options.A: CLIA laboratory certification program
options.B: Magnet Recognition Program for nursing
options.C: NCQA
options.D: ISQua external evaluation of accreditors

questions.explanation_en: NCQA accredits health plans and uses HEDIS measures.
questions.explanation_ar: NCQA تعتمد الخطط الصحية وتستخدم مقاييس HEDIS.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: A hospital is considering disease-specific certification for its heart failure program. Which question is MOST important in the decision?

options.A: Which one do competitors avoid?
options.B: Which certification requires the least data collection and reporting?
options.C: Which certification has the cheapest application and annual fees?
options.D: Does it fit strategy, payer needs, and program improvement?

questions.explanation_en: Recognition options should be selected for strategic and regulatory fit, not convenience.
questions.explanation_ar: اختر الشهادة لملاءمتها الاستراتيجية والمتطلبات لا لسهولتها.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: The Baldrige Performance Excellence Program recognizes what?

options.A: Building fire safety and life safety compliance only
options.B: Organization-wide performance excellence
options.C: Laboratory testing accuracy
options.D: Individual nurse specialty certification and competence

questions.explanation_en: Baldrige criteria assess integrated organizational performance management.
questions.explanation_ar: برنامج بالدريج يعترف بالتميز المؤسسي الشامل.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: In Saudi Arabia, which body provides national accreditation of healthcare facilities?

options.A: CBAHI
options.B: NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance)
options.C: ANCC (American Nurses Credentialing Center)
options.D: CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)

questions.explanation_en: CBAHI is the national accreditation body in Saudi Arabia; the exam itself uses US/international examples.
questions.explanation_ar: سباهي هو المركز السعودي لاعتماد المنشآت الصحية.

questions.task_name: Evaluate appropriate accreditation, certification, and recognition options
questions.stem: A hospital with deemed status receives an unannounced CMS validation survey. A manager says, 'We are accredited, so CMS cannot survey us.' What is correct?

options.A: The manager is correct
options.B: Only the state health department can survey accredited hospitals
options.C: CMS may still do validation and complaint surveys
options.D: The hospital can refuse the survey because it is already accredited

questions.explanation_en: Deemed status does not exempt a hospital from CMS validation or complaint surveys.
questions.explanation_ar: الوضع المعتبر لا يمنع مسوحات التحقق والشكاوى من CMS.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: A new CMS requirement takes effect in 6 months. Which tool BEST helps the organization track applicability, owners, and deadlines for multiple new regulations?

options.A: The annual employee recognition and events calendar
options.B: A suggestion box placed outside the compliance office
options.C: A one-time email to all staff when the rule is published
options.D: A regulatory tracking log with owners and deadlines

questions.explanation_en: A structured tracking system ensures each requirement has an owner, a deadline, and follow-up.
questions.explanation_ar: سجل تتبع اللوائح بالمالك والموعد يضمن المتابعة.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: A nurse posts a patient's photo on social media with no name visible. Which requirement is MOST likely violated?

options.A: Patient privacy rules (e.g., HIPAA)
options.B: Stark Law on physician self-referral
options.C: EMTALA screening and stabilization rules
options.D: Life Safety Code fire protection standards

questions.explanation_en: Photos can identify a patient and are protected health information; privacy training must cover social media.
questions.explanation_ar: صورة المريض معلومات صحية محمية ونشرها مخالفة للخصوصية.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: Which law prohibits physicians from referring Medicare patients for designated health services to entities with which they have a financial relationship, with certain exceptions?

options.A: HIPAA Privacy Rule
options.B: EMTALA (emergency treatment law)
options.C: Stark Law
options.D: HCQIA (peer review immunity law)

questions.explanation_en: The Stark Law addresses physician self-referral; the Anti-Kickback Statute addresses remuneration for referrals.
questions.explanation_ar: قانون ستارك يمنع الإحالة الذاتية للأطباء لجهات لهم فيها مصلحة مالية.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: An ED patient with an unstable condition is uninsured. The registrar asks for a deposit before the physician examines him. What is the BEST action?

options.A: Ask the patient to return when insured
options.B: Stop the payment inquiry; screen and stabilize without delay
options.C: Transfer the patient to a public hospital before any examination
options.D: Collect the deposit first, then begin the medical screening exam

questions.explanation_en: EMTALA prohibits delaying screening or stabilization to inquire about payment.
questions.explanation_ar: لا يجوز تأخير الفحص أو التثبيت للسؤال عن الدفع.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: Which education approach is MOST effective when a new restraint and seclusion regulation affects nursing units?

options.A: Training only nurse managers, who will pass it on informally
options.B: Role-specific training for affected staff with competency checks
options.C: Waiting for surveyors to explain the regulation during the next visit
options.D: Posting the full regulation text in the staff cafeteria and lounges

questions.explanation_en: Targeted, role-specific education with validation builds compliance better than mass posting.
questions.explanation_ar: تدريب موجّه للفئات المتأثرة مع التحقق من الكفاءة.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: Which law allows whistleblowers to report fraudulent billing to the government and imposes penalties for false claims?

options.A: False Claims Act
options.B: PSQIA (Patient Safety Act)
options.C: Stark Law (self-referral)
options.D: EMTALA (emergency care law)

questions.explanation_en: The False Claims Act penalizes knowingly submitting false claims and includes whistleblower (qui tam) provisions.
questions.explanation_ar: قانون المطالبات الكاذبة يعاقب الفوترة الاحتيالية ويحمي المبلّغين.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: A department director says a new medication-storage regulation does not apply because 'we have always done it this way and never been cited.' What should the quality professional do?

options.A: Review applicability with the director and document a gap analysis
options.B: Accept the director's view, since there have been no prior citations
options.C: Report the director to the regulator for refusing to comply
options.D: Wait for the next survey citation to confirm whether the rule applies

questions.explanation_en: Past absence of citations does not prove compliance; applicability must be assessed objectively.
questions.explanation_ar: عدم وجود مخالفات سابقة لا يثبت الامتثال؛ قيّم الانطباق بموضوعية.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: Who should be responsible for interpreting how a new regulation applies to clinical operations?

options.A: The newest employee, who has the most recent orientation training
options.B: The patient relations office alone
options.C: Only the accreditation surveyor during the next on-site visit
options.D: Process owners, supported by compliance, quality, and legal

questions.explanation_en: Ownership sits with operational leaders, supported by compliance and quality experts.
questions.explanation_ar: أصحاب العمليات بدعم من الامتثال والجودة والقانون مسؤولون عن التطبيق.

questions.task_name: Promote awareness of statutory and regulatory requirements within the organization
questions.stem: Medicare Conditions of Participation are published and enforced by which agency?

options.A: NAHQ (National Association for Healthcare Quality)
options.B: AHRQ (Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality)
options.C: CMS
options.D: The Joint Commission and other accrediting bodies

questions.explanation_en: CMS sets and enforces CoPs; accreditors may be granted deeming authority.
questions.explanation_ar: CMS تصدر شروط المشاركة وتطبقها.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: A system tracer on medication management is MOST likely to examine which of the following?

options.A: Patient satisfaction with meals and the hospital food service
options.B: A single patient's entire stay from admission through discharge
options.C: Only the pharmacy's staffing schedules and overtime records
options.D: Medication flow from procurement to monitoring across units

questions.explanation_en: System tracers evaluate an organization-wide process across departments.
questions.explanation_ar: التتبع النظامي يفحص عملية شاملة مثل إدارة الأدوية عبر الأقسام.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: Monthly audits show fire-extinguisher checks at 100% compliance on paper, but a surveyor finds several expired extinguishers. What is the BEST conclusion?

options.A: Paper audits are sufficient, so the surveyor's finding can be appealed
options.B: Expired extinguishers are acceptable if monthly checks were documented
options.C: Monitoring is not checking real conditions and must be redesigned
options.D: The surveyor is mistaken, because the audit shows 100% compliance

questions.explanation_en: Compliance monitoring must verify real conditions, not only documentation.
questions.explanation_ar: طريقة المراقبة لا تتحقق من الواقع ويجب إعادة تصميمها.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: After a citation for incomplete restraint orders, which corrective action is STRONGEST?

options.A: Remind physicians about restraint orders at the next staff meeting
options.B: Post a reminder sign about restraint orders in the nursing station
options.C: A hard-stop EHR restraint order plus weekly monitoring
options.D: Discipline the nurse on duty

questions.explanation_en: System changes plus measurable monitoring create sustainable compliance.
questions.explanation_ar: تعديل النظام بقيود إلزامية مع مراقبة أسبوعية هو الإجراء الأقوى.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: Which is a core element of an effective corporate compliance program?

options.A: Training with consistent enforcement of standards
options.B: Anonymous reporting is prohibited to prevent false accusations
options.C: Elimination of internal audits to build trust with departments
options.D: Guaranteed zero deficiencies

questions.explanation_en: Recognized elements include policies, compliance officer, training, communication lines, auditing, enforcement, and response.
questions.explanation_ar: التدريب والتطبيق المتسق للمعايير من عناصر برنامج الامتثال.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: Hand-hygiene compliance needs a sample that represents all shifts. What monitoring approach is BEST?

options.A: Have each nurse self-report hand-hygiene compliance at end of shift
options.B: Stratified observation of all shifts by trained, rotating observers
options.C: Observe only during the day shift on weekdays when managers are present
options.D: Observe only when the unit manager is present to ensure accuracy

questions.explanation_en: Representative, unbiased sampling gives a valid picture of compliance.
questions.explanation_ar: عينة طبقية لجميع المناوبات بمراقبين مدربين تعطي صورة صحيحة.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: An internal audit finds 15% of credential files missing current license verification. What should be done FIRST?

options.A: Verify licensure now, then fix the tracking process
options.B: Delete the audit results
options.C: Suspend all practitioners until every file has been rechecked
options.D: Wait for the next reappointment cycle to update the files

questions.explanation_en: Patient safety risk from unverified licensure is addressed first; the process is then corrected.
questions.explanation_ar: تحقق فوراً من التراخيص الناقصة ثم أصلح عملية التتبع.

questions.task_name: Support processes for evaluating, monitoring, and improving compliance with organizational, state, and federal requirements
questions.stem: Primary source verification of a nurse's education is BEST accomplished by what?

options.A: Reviewing a diploma photocopy
options.B: Confirming directly with the issuing school
options.C: Checking the education listed on the nurse's online professional profile
options.D: Accepting the nurse's signed attestation of the degree earned

questions.explanation_en: PSV requires confirmation from the original source or approved equivalent.
questions.explanation_ar: التحقق من المصدر الأساسي يكون مباشرة من الجهة المانحة.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: Three months before an expected survey window, the CEO proposes cancelling vacation for all managers to 'prepare.' What is the BEST advice?

options.A: Agree, and run daily mock surveys only in the final month before the survey
options.B: Hire temporary staff to cover gaps so problems are less visible to surveyors
options.C: Ask the accreditor for a delay
options.D: Strengthen ongoing readiness, such as monthly tracers

questions.explanation_en: Continuous readiness built into routine work is more effective and sustainable than surges.
questions.explanation_ar: عزّز الجاهزية المستمرة بدلاً من الاستعداد المكثف في اللحظة الأخيرة.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: Mock tracer results show staff answer correctly only when using memorized scripts and cannot explain actual processes. What does this indicate?

options.A: Readiness is excellent
options.B: More scripts should be written so staff can answer every question
options.C: Surveyors will not notice scripted answers if staff sound confident
options.D: Readiness is superficial; real understanding must be built

questions.explanation_en: Surveyors assess real understanding; scripted answers are a red flag.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابات المحفوظة تدل على جاهزية سطحية.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: During an unannounced survey, a surveyor asks a nurse a question she cannot answer. What is the BEST response?

options.A: Refuse to answer and ask the surveyor to speak with the manager instead
options.B: Give her best guess confidently
options.C: Send the surveyor to another unit where staff know the topic better
options.D: Explain how she would find the answer, e.g., the policy

questions.explanation_en: Knowing how to find accurate information is acceptable and demonstrates a safe process.
questions.explanation_ar: الأفضل أن توضح كيف ستجد الإجابة من السياسة أو المسؤول.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: Which document is MOST useful for continuous readiness by tracking each standard, its evidence, owner, and status?

options.A: The visitor log kept at the main entrance
options.B: A standards compliance matrix
options.C: The payroll register and staff timesheets
options.D: The annual operating budget and capital plan

questions.explanation_en: A compliance matrix links each standard to owners and evidence for ongoing self-assessment.
questions.explanation_ar: مصفوفة الامتثال للمعايير تتبع المالك والدليل والحالة.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: After a survey, the hospital receives several findings. What should happen to sustain compliance after the plan of correction is accepted?

options.A: Stop monitoring once the plan of correction has been accepted
options.B: Wait for the next scheduled survey to check whether fixes held
options.C: Discipline the staff members named in the survey report
options.D: Keep monitoring and reporting until compliance is sustained

questions.explanation_en: Plans of correction require evidence of sustained compliance over time.
questions.explanation_ar: استمر في مراقبة المجالات المصححة حتى تثبت الاستدامة.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: A hospital's survey readiness program includes quarterly mock surveys, but the same environment-of-care findings recur each time. What is the BEST next step?

options.A: Ignore them as minor issues
options.B: Do an RCA of recurring findings and assign owners for fixes
options.C: Change the mock surveyors so the findings are seen with fresh eyes
options.D: Increase the frequency of mock surveys without changing anything else

questions.explanation_en: Recurring findings show that causes were not addressed; analyze and fix the system.
questions.explanation_ar: تكرار الملاحظات يتطلب تحليل الأسباب وإصلاح النظام.

questions.task_name: Maintain survey or accreditation readiness
questions.stem: Which role is MOST appropriate for the quality department in survey readiness?

options.A: Accompany surveyors at all times to prevent unplanned staff interviews
options.B: Coordinate readiness and support the leaders who own compliance
options.C: Own all compliance alone so that clinical leaders can focus on care
options.D: Prepare written answers for staff to memorize before the survey

questions.explanation_en: Quality facilitates and coordinates; operational leaders and the board are accountable.
questions.explanation_ar: قسم الجودة ينسّق ويدعم، والمسؤولية على القيادات والوحدات.
